title: kate-ui: show the settings window and save the config
summary: cmd-, opens a settings window with one row per SettingsField. An edit applies through apply_setting to the workspace config at once and shows the error sentence when the value is bad. Save writes the config with save_editor_config to user_config_path. New documents use the new defaults.

lane.reason: A Cursor local agent on the owner Mac codes this packet. session.rs imports GPUI, the crate builds only on macOS, and the owner looks at the window after the change.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Open a second GPUI window of 480 by 360 px titled Settings with a label and a text field per row, a Save button, and a notice line. Bind cmd-, and add Settings to the KateM5Rust menu. The test config_path_for_home_uses_the_support_directory asserts Some(/Users/x) gives a path that ends with Library/Application Support/KateM5Rust/config.toml and None gives None. The owner changes the tab width, saves, and opens a new file. Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: session::tests::config_path_for_home_uses_the_support_directory
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because config_path_for_home does not exist. After the change the path sits under the application support directory.
